use_case_summary: Workload: document search and RAG for small law firms. Will run nightly batch embedding jobs and online similarity queries. Latency target: 150-300ms for top-K retrieval on common queries; peak concurrent queries low (tens). Cost sensitivity: high — favors smaller embed models and caching. Model preferences: trial local/economy embed models (affordable) + stronger generation model for reranking/QA (hosted). Routing/fallback: prefer single hosted lane; want option to fallback to cheaper embed model if cost spikes. Security/compliance: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs required; no strict data residency yet. Integration: wanting recommended vector DB connectors, examples for hybrid search (keyword + vector + rerank).
